ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode
ErrorCode.description: The stable error taxonomy. The wire spelling is `snake_case`; a caller branches on the code, never on the message.

oneOf.description: The request failed validation; `context.field` names the field.
The caller is not authenticated or not allowed to.
The addressed resource does not exist.
The request conflicts with the current state (e.g. a duplicate id).
The route exists in the contract but is not implemented in this build.
The addressed payload was written against a version this build does not read.
An internal failure; never a caller's fault.
The operation timed out and may succeed if retried.
A pre-trade risk check refused the order.
The operator has halted trading (ADR 0018 rule 1): every placement is refused.
The platform is reduce-only and the order would add exposure (ADR 0018 rule 2).
A market order's expected touch is outside the configured price collar.
The order quantity is not a multiple of the instrument's lot size.
A limit price is off the instrument's tick grid.
The instrument is not in the master catalogue (ADR 0018 rule 3).
A rate limit was exceeded (e.g. the approval queue is full).

QuoteTick.title: QuoteTick
QuoteTick.description:
The top-of-book quote read model (`GET /quotes`).

The transport-level view of [`tantra_core::Tick`]'s quote arm, without the band enrichment, so a plain quote list stays a flat record.

ResponseEnvelope.title: ResponseEnvelope_for_AnyValue
ResponseEnvelope.description:
The response envelope every transport wraps a payload in (ADR 0012).

A success carries `data`; a failure carries `error`. Both are optional on the wire so a payload from a newer server (extra fields, both absent) still parses for an older client.

api_version.description: The API version the server answered under.

data.description: The payload; absent on a failure.

error.description: The failure; absent on a success.

schema_version.description: The wire schema version the payload was written against.

RiskLimits.title: RiskLimits
RiskLimits.description:
Hard risk limits applied synchronously to all outgoing orders and decisions.

This struct merges rules from `tantra-ledger::RiskLimits` (deprecated) with the canonical tantra-risk risk limit schema.

Legacy fields from `tantra-ledger` (mapped during Phase 1.2): - `max_notional` (f64, per-order notional ceiling) → `max_notional_per_order` (Decimal) - `max_participation` (f64, fraction of ADV) → `max_quantity_per_order` (Quantity) - `order_rate` (OrderRateLimit) → `order_rate_limit` (OrderRateLimit) - `stale_after_ms` (u64, feed staleness) → tracked via separate circuit breaker

New tantra-risk fields: - `max_daily_loss` (Decimal, daily cumulative loss limit) - `price_collar_bps` (u32, market order deviation collar in basis points)

freeze_limits.description: Per-scrip freeze limits (exchange single-order quantity ceilings). Maps instrument to maximum allowed quantity per single order. Examples: NIFTY → 1,800, BANKNIFTY → 900.

max_daily_loss.description: Maximum allowable daily cumulative loss (in INR).

max_mis_leverage.description: Maximum gross leverage for intraday (MIS) products. E.g., 5.0 means max 5x leverage on gross exposure vs equity.

max_notional_per_order.description: Maximum notional value (in INR) permitted per single order. `None` = no notional rule; `Some` must be finite and `> 0`.

max_position_concentration_pct.description: Maximum single-scrip position concentration as a percentage of total portfolio equity (e.g., 10.0 means max 10% in any one scrip).

max_quantity_per_order.description: Maximum quantity permitted per single order.

order_rate_limit.description: Global order rate limit across the platform.

price_collar_bps.description: Allowed market order deviation collar in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

Trade.title: Trade
Trade.description:
The trade read model (`GET /trades` and the journal fill records): one realized execution.

This is the transport-owned wire view of [`tantra_core::FillReport`], kept a distinct type so the wire shape is this surface's contract, not the kernel's: the traded instrument is named `instrument_id` (matching every other wire record on this surface) while the kernel field stays `instrument`. A `Trade` converts losslessly from a [`FillReport`].

account_id.description: Optional account ID (defaults to "default" if not provided)

fee.description: Total transaction cost charged on this fill (brokerage, statutory levies, and exchange charges combined), in the fill's currency.

fee_breakdown.description: Itemized breakdown of [`Trade::fee`], when the caller has it.

TradingState.description: The operator trading state every write route evaluates against (ADR 0018).
